_comment: The website's settings (website/build.py, docs/conventions/build-and-release.md §12). base_url is where Cloudflare Pages serves the site (project `woodcore`, deployed by .github/workflows/site.yml; the site was on GitLab Pages until v0.117) and what calc/tools/updates.py's FEED_URL points into -- tests/test_site.py holds every copy of it equal to this one. releases_repo is the public GitHub repository whose Releases carry the installers (packaging/publish.py uploads them, the program accepts an installer only from there: calc/tools/updates.py INSTALLER_PREFIX), the installer being too large for a Cloudflare Pages file (25 MiB). masked: the example pages the public site does not show, because they set a norm table in full (the engineer's choice, v0.89): SIA 261 Tabelle 8 (show-live-load at level 3) and SIA 265 Tabellen 24 to 41 (#distance, and the minimum distances show-connector-resistance prints). Their code and their calls stay; their picture is replaced by a note. Globs on the example's stem. hero_example, levels_example and gallery name worked examples by their stem (show-calc-1 is show-calc's first): the code the home page shows beside a picture is that example's own fence, and the command an example belongs to is read off it, so neither is written here a second time. moved: the addresses the site no longer has a page at, each with the address of the page that replaced it, both read from a language's root: the build writes at the old one, in every language, a small page that sends the reader on (v0.96: the tutorial's step on the window, tutorial/katalog/ while the window was the Katalog).
